question:
Select the appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abandon
solution:
The correct answer is: **Relinquish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abandon"** means to leave something or someone completely, often with no intention of returning. (छोड़ देना)

 
 
• **Example:** The old house was abandoned after the flood destroyed it.
 
 
 
• **"Relinquish"** means to give up something, such as a right, possession, or power, voluntarily or due to force. (त्याग देना)
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to relinquish his claim to the inheritance.
 
 
 
• Both "Abandon" and "Relinquish" convey the idea of giving up or leaving something, making "Relinquish" the correct synonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Relinquish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Maintain** (बनाए रखना): To keep something in good condition or to continue in the same state.

 
 
• **Example:** It is important to maintain a healthy diet for overall well-being.
 
 
 
• **Retain** (रखना): To keep possession of something.
 
 
• **Example:** She retained all her old textbooks for future reference.
 
 
 
• **Preserve** (संरक्षित करना): To protect something from harm or destruction, ensuring it remains in its original state.
 
 
• **Example:** Efforts are being made to preserve endangered species.
